prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landscape product-design comp for a greenfield native macOS application
Primary request: Design the Operate mode of an AI-native iOS development environment as an app-led verification bay. The main focus is a large live-running iPhone app screenshot beside a semantic accessibility hierarchy inspector. Compact Code and Agent working layers are docked on the left. A full-width evidence ledger runs across the bottom.
Scene/backdrop: one native macOS application window, straight-on orthographic view, filling the canvas against a quiet neutral desktop background
Style/medium: polished high-fidelity native macOS interface concept, precise product design, blueprint-layer workbench language, credible implementation-ready UI
Composition/framing: 16:10 landscape. Standard macOS titlebar and unified toolbar at top. Slim left vertical navigation with the exact labels Code, Agent, App, Verify; App selected. Left dock contains a compact code editor layer above a compact agent activity/timeline layer. The dominant center bay shows a large portrait iPhone simulator screenshot running a plausible Profile screen. The right bay is a semantic hierarchy inspector with nested accessibility elements and a selected row. Across the full bottom, show an evidence ledger with fresh build, launch, UI assertion, screenshot, and runtime log entries. Keep strong visual hierarchy and dense-but-calm professional spacing.
Color palette: restrained matte graphite and cool charcoal surfaces, blueprint blue for selection and technical structure, verified green only for successful evidence and status, off-white text, muted gray secondary text
Materials/textures: flat opaque panels, hairline dividers, subtle native macOS shadows only, crisp 1px rules, no decorative texture
Text (verbatim): "Code", "Agent", "App", "Verify", "Build", "Run", "Stop", "Verified"
Additional credible UI copy: scheme "ProfileApp", simulator "iPhone 17 Pro", configuration "Debug", task status "Verified", hierarchy nodes "Application", "NavigationBar", "Profile", "Edit Profile", evidence rows "Build", "Launch", "UI assertion", "Screenshot", "Runtime log". Use compact SF-like typography; all readable text should be correctly spelled.
Constraints: Operate mode, App-led composition option C; make the running iPhone screenshot and semantic hierarchy the visual center; clearly show the selected hierarchy element linked by a fine blueprint-blue annotation line to the corresponding UI element in the phone screenshot; evidence ledger must communicate freshness and machine-recorded verification without unsupported product claims; native macOS controls and toolbar proportions; realistic developer-tool density; visible exact navigation and toolbar labels; large legible application window
Avoid: gradients, glassmorphism, frosted glass, excessive translucency, card grid, floating card collage, neon, purple, playful consumer-app styling, sci-fi HUD, fake marketing metrics, fake customer claims, fake performance claims, fake company logos, fake testimonials, busy wallpaper, illegible microtext, warped phone hardware, browser chrome, Windows styling, overly rounded panels, decorative illustrations
